newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit in 10-point range on lack of interest.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit in 10-point range on lack of interest.

text.p: The ringgit was trading in a 10-point range for most of the Asian day, after recovering from a marginal decline in mid-session due to dollar demand from Kuala Lumpur, dealers said on Monday.
"It is the year-end syndrome. Virtually nothing is happening," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank.
He said activity had dropped further due as many dealers were on leave ahead of Christmas on Wednesday.
Dealers said the ringgit would remain in a 20-30 point range until after Christmas.
They said the mid-session dollar demand from Kuala Lumpur ended with a few quick deals.
Most dealers said the traditional year-end activity ahead of accounts closing by local commercial banks, as well as the central bank was also subdued this year.
At 1030 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5272/82 a dollar.
